Crime & Law · India

Multiple bodies found in separate incidents across India

In Raipur, five members of a family were found dead, with the husband suspected of killing his wife and children before hanging himself, reportedly due to financial distress. In Delhi's Amar Colony, a woman's body was discovered on a bed while a man was found hanging from a fan, prompting a police investigation into twin mystery deaths. Elsewhere, a young man was found hanging in his home in Rudrapur, with reports suggesting he was struggling with depression. In Panipat, a man's body was found hanging at his girlfriend's house, with his family claiming it was murder, not suicide. Another incident in Rajarhat reported a woman's body found hanging, with her live-in partner also found injured.
